name: NightShift
description: Dusk over a miniature city. The key is a low sodium-warm sun a few degrees above the rooftops, so every building throws a long shadow down the street and the terraces read as a row of separate objects rather than as one extruded shape -- at a high key they merge into a single silhouette, which is the failure mode of every isometric city render. The fill is a broad cool sky term at a sixth of the key: warm light, cool shadow, which is the whole of what makes a frame read as evening. The bounce is warm again and comes from below, standing in for the road giving the undersides back a little of the sun.
